events.label: founding
events.text: Senate established upon Italian unification, replacing the Subalpine Senate.

evidence.quote: established on 17 March 1861 upon Italian unification

events.text: Senate moved from Turin to the Palazzo Vecchio in Florence.

evidence.quote: until 1864 when it was moved to the Palazzo Vecchio in Florence

events.text: Senate moved from Florence to the Palazzo Madama in Rome.

evidence.quote: in 1871 , it was moved to the Palazzo Madama in Rome

events.text: 211 new members added to the Senate when lower house became Chamber of Fasces and Corporations.

evidence.quote: in 1939 , when the lower house was transformed into the Chamber of Fasces and Corporations , 211 new members were added

events.text: King Victor Emmanuel III appointed Paolo Thaon di Revel as Senate President.

evidence.quote: When Fascism fell on 25 July 1943 , King Victor Emmanuel III appointed Paolo Thaon di Revel as the President of the Senate

events.text: Paolo Thaon di Revel entered office as Senate President.
Pietro Tomasi Della Torretta appointed final Senate President.

evidence.quote: On 20 July 1944 , Pietro Tomasi Della Torretta was appointed as the final President of the Senate

events.text: Senators responsible for maintaining Fascism dismissed from office.

evidence.quote: In August 1944 , all Senators responsible for maintaining Fascism

events.text: Tomasi Della Torretta's term as Senate President ended.

evidence.quote: an office which he retained until 25 June 1946

events.label: cessation
events.text: Senate of the Kingdom ceased to function.

evidence.quote: the Senate of the Kingdom ceased to function on 25 June 1946

events.label: dissolution
events.text: Senate formally suppressed, replaced by the present-day Senate of the Republic.

evidence.quote: It was formally suppressed on 7 November 1947

undated_mentions: Transformation into the Senate of the Republic
Senate lost almost all its limited power during the final years of the Fascist regime
